name: Lesopolosa
source:
Let us begin the story of fates intertwined under tree branches. The fates of inhumanly devious dealers. Sneaky shapeshifters. Mysterious femme fatales. And two simple guys who are called upon by a real jewel that can only be found in the post-Soviet suburbs. A genuine treasure.


Night. Coordinates. The woods.


May no one leave with a grudge.

[Translated from [url=https://yokarnii-babai.itch.io/lesopolosa]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
让我们开始树枝下命运交织的故事吧。惨无人道、狡诈毒贩的命运。Sneaky shapeshifters.神秘的蛇蝎美人。还有两个简单的人，他们被一颗真正的宝石所召唤，而这颗宝石只能在后苏联郊区找到。A genuine treasure.


夜晚。Coordinates. The woods.


愿没有人带着怨恨离开。

[译自[url=https://yokarnii-babai.itch.io/lesopolosa]itch.io[/url]]
